glyph.isekai_mahou.lava_geyser.desc: The ground cracks (warning circle) and a lava column bursts upward: 8 damage, a high launch and Burning 2. It keeps gushing for 2 s, tossing and burning whoever stays in it, and scorches the ground. On self: geysers under up to 3 nearby enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.volcano.desc: A mini-volcano bursts from the ground and, for 11 s, lobs lava bombs at enemies (each one telegraphed where it lands: 9 damage, Burning 2). Its base burns anyone who touches it. At the end the mountain explodes (14 damage, Burning 3) and collapses into a crater.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steam_explosion.desc: A burst of steam on the target (6 damage, leaves it Wet) and, right after, EVERY Wet or in-water enemy within 10 blocks detonates in a chain: 8 damage (12 if Wet), half to neighbours, blindness and knock-up.
glyph.isekai_mahou.steam_cannon.desc: A pressurized steam jet for 1.5 s that follows your aim: blasts away everything it hits, scalds (continuous damage and Weakness), soaks (Wet) and puts out fire. Crouch to hold your ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.railgun.desc: Electric rails align for 0.8 s (you can still aim; it can be countered) and a shot pierces EVERYTHING in a straight line for 64 blocks: 18 damage to all in its path, Shocked 2 and a tunnel bored through the terrain.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ball_lightning.desc: A plasma orb that drifts slowly for 8 s, drawn to the nearest enemy, zapping up to 3 enemies every 0.6 s (4.5 damage, Shocked; Wet targets get Electrocuted). It bursts in a flash when it hits something or expires.
glyph.isekai_mahou.absolute_zero.desc: A wave of absolute cold spreads up to 10 blocks: everyone its front passes takes 10 damage, becomes FROZEN and Chilled 3. Ice spikes erupt, water freezes, lava turns to obsidian and the ground is covered in snow.
glyph.isekai_mahou.ice_coffin.desc: A hexagonal ice crystal traps the target (Frozen, held in place) for 3 s and then SHATTERS: 12 damage (18 if it was Wet) and shards that hurt and chill anyone nearby. On self: traps up to 3 nearby enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.world_roots.desc: The ground shakes and cracks; GIANT roots burst from the earth under up to 8 enemies: they launch them (8 damage), coil around them (Rooted, squeezing 2.5/s, held aloft) and finally slam down crushing them (6 damage).
glyph.isekai_mahou.pollen_storm.desc: A whirl of pollen and petals for 8 s: enemies inside are poisoned and grow ever more Drowsy — at level III they fall asleep; allies regenerate. Pollen is flammable: a Burning enemy (or fire) in the cloud makes it all EXPLODE (12 damage, Burning 2).
glyph.isekai_mahou.sand_coffin.desc: Sand spirals up and wraps the target, lifts it and squeezes (Rooted, blinded, 3 damage/s) for 2.5 s; then the Desert Funeral: the cocoon implodes, crushing it (14 damage, Stiffening). On self: wraps up to 3 nearby enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sand_tsunami.desc: A 9-block-wide wave of sand rushes ~26 blocks toward the target following the terrain: 10 damage and drags along everyone it reaches, burying the ground it passes. When it breaks, those dragged are BURIED (trapped, blinded, suffocating).
glyph.isekai_mahou.supernova.desc: A miniature star forms at the point (1.7 s — it can be countered) and EXPLODES: 20 damage at the center (10 at the edge, ×1.5 vs undead), Burning 3, blinds those who looked, a blinding flash and a crater with scorched ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.solar_flare.desc: A beam of solar plasma for 2.5 s that follows your aim (turns slowly): burns everything it touches (continuous damage, Burning; stronger vs undead) and leaves a trail of scorched earth and fire. You move slowly while holding it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sacred_spring.desc: A marble fountain with a lotus of light rises for 12 s: every second it heals nearby allies and removes their worst ailment; enemies get Wet and the undead burn in holy water. Aim at the ground, yourself or an ally.
glyph.isekai_mahou.purge.desc: Rips ALL ailments and harmful effects from the ally (and allies right next to it) and hurls them as rays of light at nearby enemies: each takes 4 damage + 3 per ailment removed (max 40) and RECEIVES the purged ailments.
effect.isekai_mahou.pollen_drowsy.descri: Pollen in the eyes: slower with each level. At level III, falls asleep.
legend.isekai_mahou.absolute_zero.desc: Ice coffins trap the nearest enemies and, in the same instant, a wave of absolute cold bursts from you: it freezes everything, covers the ground in ice and snow and shatters the trapped.
legend.isekai_mahou.desert_funeral.desc: A homing projectile wraps its target in a sand cocoon that lifts and crushes it; right behind, a sand tsunami rushes toward it, dragging and burying everyone in its path.
legend.isekai_mahou.level5_railgun.desc: The Railgun at full power: rails charge for 0.8 s and a colossal shot pierces everything in a straight line, boring a wide tunnel through the mountain.
